blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models can both generate and understand images within a single set of weights, offering an opportunity to use image synthesis as training supervision for visual comprehension. However, existing visual chain-of-thought methods rely on human-annotated helper images during training and require slow image generation at test time. We present SelfThinker, the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified model's self-generated visual thoughts into stronger understanding without human image annotations. Given a visual problem, SelfThinker samples candidate helper images from its generation pathway and uses its frozen understanding pathway to score each candidate via conditional pointwise mutual information. High-utility visual thoughts then refine the generator via flow matching and serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation. At inference, SelfThinker reasons directly from the original image in text without generating intermediate images. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation datasets, SelfThinker transfers broadly to natural-image and spatial benchmarks, raising the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 (+11.3 points). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial perception tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker.
blocks.zh: 统一的多模式模型既可在一组加权内生成并理解图像,也提供了利用图像合成作为视觉理解培训监督的机会。 然而,现有的视觉思维链方法在训练时依赖于人附加说明的帮助者图像,需要测试时缓慢地生成图像. 我们介绍SelfThinker,这是第一个将一个统一的模型的自生视觉思想转化为没有人类形象说明的更强理解的自生自灭的框架. 由于视觉问题,SelfThinker从生成路径中取出候选帮助者图像,并使用被冻结的理解路径通过有条件的指向相互信息对每个候选者进行分分. 高功用视觉思想然后通过流量比对来完善生成器,并充当政策自我消化的特权教师背景. 推论中,SelfThinker在文本中直接从原始图像中推理,而不产生中间图像. SelfThinker虽然只接受过小型合成视觉搜索和导航数据集的培训,但广泛向自然成像和空间基准转移,将ThinkMorph-7B的7个基准平均值从52.7分提高到64.0分(+11.3分). 被控制的图像-扰动探测器进一步显示,SelfThinker超越了ThinkMorph-7B最多40.4分,其预先训练的BAGEL-7B主干线跨精细和空间感知任务最多23.2分. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/zhangquanchen/SelfThinker上查阅。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of SelfThinker . The upper-left Self-Evolution panel summarizes the closed loop of imagining candidate visual thoughts, verifying reliable ones, and evolving into a stronger model. Imagine : a shared UMM with Generation and Understanding pathways produces candidate visual thoughts and decoded answers. Verify : the frozen Understanding pathway scores each candidate by its log-likelihood utility, calibrates the acceptance threshold against thoughts from other problems, and selects the top verified thought under the ground-truth answer or majority vote. Evolve : the verified thought is distilled into the Student Understanding pathway via on-policy token-level JSD distillation from the EMA Teacher ( SelfThinker ), supported by flow-matching generator refinement ( SelfThinker -Gen). No human image annotation is used

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual understanding and spatial reasoning are foundational capabilities for multimodal large language models ( Tong et al., 2024c ; Tong et al., 2024a ; Fu et al., 2024 ) . When tackling multi-step visual tasks (e.g., grid navigation, visual search), text-only chains of thought often fall short because natural language struggles to capture fine-grained spatial geometry. Humans naturally overcome this bottleneck by forming intermediate mental images to guide deduction ( Shepard and Metzler, 1971 ; Kosslyn et al., 2001 ; Pearson et al., 2015 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Motivated by this cognitive process, recent unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding within a single set of weights ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2024b ; Deng et al., 2025 ) , enabling interleaved reasoning models to draw intermediate helper images, or visual thoughts, before predicting a final answer ( Li et al., 2025 ; Chern et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025d ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉理解和空间推理是多模式大语言模型的基础能力(Tong等,2024c;Tong等,2024a;Fu等,2024.). 在处理多步骤的视觉任务(例如:网格导航,视觉搜索)时,只用文本的思维链经常会因为自然语言为捕捉细纹空间几何而挣扎而不足. 人类自然地克服了这个瓶颈,形成了中间心理图像来引导推理(Shepard和Metzler,1971;Kosslyn等,2001;Pearson等,2015;Chen等,2025c;Chen等,2026). 受这一认知过程的驱动,最近统一的多模式模型将图像生成和视觉理解融合到一组权重中(Chameleon Team, 2024;Zhou等, 2024;Xie等, 2025;Wu等, 2024a; Wang等,2024;Tong等,2024b;Deng等,2025),使相隔推理模型在预测最终答案之前能绘制出中间辅助图像或视觉思维(Li等,2025;Chern等,2025;Gu等,2025;Chen等,2025b;Chen等,2025d.).

blocks.en: In principle, because a unified model can already synthesize images, its generation pathway could serve as a self-contained source of visual supervision to strengthen its understanding pathway. In practice, however, existing visual-thought pipelines such as Mirage ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , ThinkMorph ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , and Visual-OPSD ( Li et al., 2026a ) remain tied to external visual supervision, relying on human-designed helper images rendered by external tools (such as shortest-path overlays for navigation or bounding boxes for visual search). Constructing such task-specific templates requires costly manual engineering and confines visual imagination to predefined heuristics, preventing the model from learning from its own generated imagery at scale .
blocks.zh: 原则上,由于一个统一的模型已经能够合成图像,其生成路径可以作为自成一体的视觉监督来源来强化其理解路径. 然而,实际上,现有的视觉思维管道,如幻影(杨等,2025b),ThinkMorph(顾等,2025)和Visual-OPSD(李等,2026a)仍然与外部视觉监管相联,依靠由外部工具(如用于导航的最短路径覆盖或用于视觉搜索的边框)所制作的由人类设计的帮助者图像. 构建这种针对特定任务的模板需要昂贵的人工工程,并将视觉想象力限制在预定义的休克上,使模型无法从自己生成的图像中大规模学习。

blocks.en: Overcoming this limitation and turning a model’s image generation capability into effective training supervision for visual understanding requires addressing three core challenges: (C1) Annotation-free learning , replacing human-engineered visual templates with diverse candidate visual thoughts sampled directly from the model’s own generation pathway, without ground-truth bounding boxes, masks, or path overlays; (C2) Intrinsic verification , determining which self-generated images genuinely aid comprehension, since generated candidates are often noisy and standard majority voting over text answers ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Zuo et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Gkountouras et al., 2026 ) fails when agreeing answers accompany uninformative or corrupted intermediate images ( Li et al., 2026a ) ; and (C3) Test-time efficiency , internalizing the visual cues of helpful intermediate images back into the understanding pathway, so that deployment neither incurs slow image generation latency nor halts prematurely at the image token.
blocks.zh: 克服这种限制,将模型的图像生成能力转化为视觉理解的有效培训监督,需要应对三个核心挑战:(C1) 无注释学习,用直接取自模型自身生成路径的各种不同候选视觉思维取而代之的人类工程视觉模板取而代之,没有地面-真实的框框、口罩或路径覆盖;(C2) 内在核查,确定哪些自生成的图像真正有助于理解,因为所生成的候选者往往很吵,对文本答案进行标准多数投票(Wang等人,2023;Huang等人,2023;Zuo等人,2025;Li等人,2026b;Gkountouras等人,2026)在商定与非成型或被腐蚀的中间图像(Li等人,2026a;和(C3)测试时间效率,将有用的中间图像的视觉提示内化回理解路径,这样部署不会缓慢生成图像,也不会过早地停止图像信号。

blocks.en: To address (C1)–(C3), we propose SelfThinker (Fig. 1 ), a self-evolving framework structured into three stages: Imagine , Verify , and Evolve . In the Imagine stage, given a visual problem, the model samples multiple candidate visual thoughts from its generation pathway and decodes their corresponding answers, supplying diverse visual candidates without human image annotations (resolving C1). In the Verify stage, the model’s frozen understanding pathway acts as an intrinsic verifier, scoring each candidate image by its conditional pointwise mutual information with a target answer direction and calibrating the score against thoughts drawn for other problems to filter out conflicting imagery (resolving C2). In the Evolve stage, the verified visual thoughts serve as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation ( SelfThinker ), transferring their visual cues into the understanding pathway so the student model reasons directly from the original image in text at test time (resolving C3), while a supporting flow-matching update ( SelfThinker -Gen) refines the generator to produce cleaner candidate imagery.
blocks.zh: 为了解决(C1)—(C3),我们提议自发(图1),一个自发演变的框架结构分为三个阶段:想象、验证和演变。 在"想象"阶段,由于视觉问题,模型从它的生成路径中取样了多个候选视觉想法,并解码了相应的答案,提供了不同的视觉候选人,没有人类图像说明(解析C1). 在验证阶段,模型的被冻结的理解路径起到内在的验证作用,通过有条件的点对点相互信息对每个候选图像进行评分,并设定目标答案方向,根据对其他问题的想法对分分进行校正,以过滤相冲突的图像(解决C2)。 在Evolve阶段,经过验证的视觉思维充当了在政策上自我消化(SelfThinker)的特权教师背景,将视觉提示转移到理解路径中,因此学生模型在测试时间(解析C3)直接从原始图像中解释原因,而支持的流相匹配更新(SelfThinker-Gen)则完善了生成器以生成更清洁的候选图像.

blocks.en: Beyond eliminating human image annotations and test-time drawing overhead, our experiments also reveal a striking property, i.e., self-generated visual supervision transfers broadly across tasks . Although SelfThinker is trained only on small synthetic visual-search and grid-navigation pools, its improvements generalize across seven diverse multimodal benchmarks, spanning fine-grained chart reading and visual search, multi-step spatial planning, and natural-scene perception. Specifically, SelfThinker raises the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B from 52.7 to 64.0 ( + 11.3 +11.3 points) under ground-truth answer supervision, and to 63.4 ( + 10.7 +10.7 points) under label-free majority voting. Controlled image-perturbation probes further confirm that this cross-task transfer stems from stronger visual perception rather than output formatting or language priors. That is, SelfThinker consistently outperforms teacher-context controls that lack verified imagery, surpassing ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and its pretrained BAGEL-7B-MoT backbone by 12.0 to 23.2 points across fine-grained and spatial benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 除了取消人类形象说明和试验时间绘图外,我们的实验还揭示出一个引人注目的地物,即自我产生的视觉监督在任务之间广泛转移。 虽然SelfThinker只接受小型合成视觉搜索和网格导航池的培训,但其改进一般涵盖7个不同的多模式基准,包括精细的图读取和视觉搜索、多步骤的空间规划和自然景观感知。 具体而言,SelfThinker将ThinkMorph-7B的7个基准平均值从52.7升至64.0分(+11.3+11.3分),在地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地---------------------------------- 被控制的图像-扰动探测器进一步证实,这种跨任务传输源于更强的视觉感知,而不是输出格式化或语言前传. 也就是说,SelfThinker一贯比缺乏可核实图像的师文控制高12.0至23.2分,超过ThinkMorph-7B,超过40.4分,超过BAGEL-7B-MoT的预训主干线超过精细和空间基准。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows. • We propose SelfThinker , the first self-evolving framework that turns a unified multimodal model’s image generation capability into training supervision for visual understanding without human image annotations. • We introduce an intrinsic visual verification mechanism based on calibrated conditional pointwise mutual information, enabling the understanding pathway to select informative self-generated helper images. • We develop a privileged on-policy self-distillation scheme, supported by flow-matching generator refinement, that internalizes verified visual thoughts into the understanding pathway for fast text-only inference without test-time image generation. • Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and controlled image-perturbation probes demonstrate that SelfThinker consistently outperforms strong baselines and its pretrained backbone. Furthermore, our results indicate that SelfThinker generalizes effectively from synthetic training pools to natural-image and spatial perception, highlighting its broad applicability.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下。 我们提议建立SelfThinker,这是第一个将统一的多模式的图像生成能力转化为培训监督的自我演变框架,在没有人类图像说明的情况下进行视觉理解。 我们采用了基于校准的有分点的相互信息的内在视觉核查机制,使理解路径能够选择信息化的自我生成的帮助者图像。 我们开发了一种特权性的政策性自我消化计划,辅以流量匹配生成器的完善,将经过核实的视觉思维内部化为理解路径,以便在不产生测试时间图像的情况下快速进行文本唯一推断。 • 跨越多个基准和受控图像扰动探测器的广泛实验表明,SelfThinker的业绩一贯超过强有力的基线及其预先训练的骨干。 此外,我们的结果表明,SelfThinker有效地概括了从合成培训池到自然成像和空间感知,突出了其广泛适用性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Unified Multimodal Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 统一多式联运模式

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding and image generation within a single architecture. Early-fusion autoregressive models such as Chameleon ( Chameleon Team, 2024 ) and Emu3 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) represent both modalities as discrete token streams. In contrast, Transfusion ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and Show-o ( Xie et al., 2025 ) combine next-token prediction with continuous diffusion or discrete denoising. Janus and Janus-Pro decouple the visual encoders used for reading and generation ( Wu et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , whereas MetaMorph aligns an understanding backbone with visual generation via instruction tuning ( Tong et al., 2024b ) . BAGEL routes understanding and generation tokens through specialized transformer experts pretrained on interleaved multimodal data ( Deng et al., 2025 ) . At the evaluation level, standard multimodal benchmarks often suffer from language shortcuts where questions can be answered without inspecting the image ( Chen et al., 2024a ) . This limitation has motivated vision-centric benchmarks such as MMVP, CV-Bench, and BlindTest ( Tong et al., 2024c ; Tong et al., 2024a ; Rahmanzadehgervi et al., 2024 ) , alongside image corruption robustness protocols ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) . SelfThinker builds on a unified architecture to convert its generative capability into stronger visual perception across fine-grained and spatial benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 统一的多式模型(UMM)将视觉理解和图像生成整合在一个单一的架构内. 早期聚变自旋模型如Chameleon (Chameleon Team, 2024)和 Emu3 (Wang等, 2024) 代表了两种模式作为离散的符号流. 相形之下,输血(周等,2024年)和Show-o(谢等,2025年)结合了下接的预测与连续扩散或离散去诺. Janus和Janus-Pro将用于读取和生成的视觉编码器解开(Wu等,2024a; Chen等,2025a.),而MetaMorph则通过指令调谐使理解主干线与视觉生成相配合(Tong等,2024b.). BAGEL通过专业的变压器专家预先对互换多式数据进行了培训(Deng等,2025年)。 在评价一级,标准多模式基准往往受到语言快捷方式的影响,在这些快捷方式中,问题可以在不检查图像的情况下得到回答(Chen等,2024a.)。 这一限制促使制定了以视觉为中心的基准,如MMVP、CV-Bench和Blind Test等(Tong等,2024c; Tong等,2024a;Rahmanzadehgervi等,2024),与图像腐败强性协议(Hendrycks和Dietrich,2019)并列. SelfThinker以统一的架构为基础,将基因能力转化为跨越精细和空间基准的更强视觉感知.

blocks.en: 2.2 Reasoning with Helper Images
blocks.zh: 2.2 用助手图像说明理由

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of SelfThinker with related visual-thought and self-distillation methods across five key properties: reasoning with intermediate visual thoughts, learning from the model’s own self-generated visual thoughts rather than external tools or curated datasets, operating without human image annotations (bounding boxes, masks, or path overlays), explicitly verifying candidate visual thoughts, and supporting text-only inference at test time
blocks.zh: 表1:SelfThinker与5个关键属性的相关视觉思维和自我消化方法的比较:与中间视觉思维的推理,学习模型自己自生的视觉思维而不是外部工具或被整理的数据集,操作时没有人类图像说明(边框,口罩,或路径覆盖),明确验证候选视觉思维,测试时支持仅文本的推论.

blocks.en: To move beyond text-only chains of thought, recent multimodal reasoning methods construct intermediate helper images that supply explicit visual cues during deduction. Tool-augmented systems such as Visual Sketchpad and Whiteboard-of-Thought invoke external code and drawing APIs to render auxiliary lines, boxes, and diagrams ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Menon et al., 2024 ) , while region-focusing methods crop or zoom into informative sub-regions ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2025 ) . Mirage synthesizes task-specific helper images, such as path-annotated maps, and compresses them into latent visual tokens during training ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . Within native UMMs, MVoT generates step-by-step spatial visualizations ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and Chern et al. (2025) sample and critique intermediate images at test time. ThinkMorph fine-tunes BAGEL on interleaved traces across human-annotated helper-image templates, including red bounding boxes for visual search, shortest-path overlays for navigation, and region highlights for chart reading ( Gu et al., 2025 ) . However, these approaches rely on external rendering tools or human annotation pipelines to prescribe task-specific helper images. In contrast, SelfThinker uses the model’s own generation pathway as a source of visual training supervision without human image annotations, selects informative visual thoughts via the understanding pathway, and distills them into single-image text reasoning.
blocks.zh: 为了超越只使用文本的思维链,最近的多模式推理方法构建了中间辅助图像,在扣除时提供明确的视觉提示. 诸如Visual Sketchpad和Whiteboard-of-Thought等工具化系统援引外部代码并绘制API来制取辅助线条,盒子和图表(Hu等,2024;Menon等,2024;而区域重点方法则收成或放大成信息化分地区(Shao等,2024;Zheng等,2025;Fan等,2025). 幻影综合了特定任务辅助图像,如路径附加说明的地图,并在训练期间将图像压缩为潜在的视觉符号(Yang等,2025b.). 在原生的UMM中,MVoT生成分步空间可视化(Li等,2025年),Chern等. (2025)在测试时间采样并批评中间图像. ThinkMorph微调了BAGEL在人类附加说明的帮助-图像模板上的互出痕迹,包括用于视觉搜索的红色边框、用于导航的最短路径覆盖和用于图表阅读的区域亮点(Gu等人,2025年)。 然而,这些方法依赖于外部渲染工具或人文注释管道来规定特定任务帮助者图像. 反之,SelfThinker将模型本身的一代路径作为视觉训练监督的源泉,没有人类图像说明,通过理解路径选择信息化的视觉思维,并将其分解为单一图像文本推理.

blocks.en: 2.3 Self-Evolving Training
blocks.zh: 2.3 自发培训

blocks.en: Self-evolving training frameworks iteratively improve model capability without human rationales by filtering self-generated trajectories ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ; Gulcehre et al., 2023 ; Dong et al., 2023 ; Yuan et al., 2023 ) or optimizing against outcome rewards and self-play ( Chen et al., 2024b ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) . Related work also evaluates whether intermediate steps genuinely contribute to predictions via pointwise mutual information (PMI) and counterfactual interventions ( Church and Hanks, 1990 ; Koh and Liang, 2017 ; Lanham et al., 2023 ; Turpin et al., 2023 ) . A complementary paradigm is learning using privileged information ( Vapnik and Vashist, 2009 ; Hinton et al., 2015 ; Lopez-Paz et al., 2016 ) , which supplies a teacher with training signals that are unavailable to the student at test time. Combining privileged context with on-policy context distillation ( Askell et al., 2021 ; Snell et al., 2022 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ) allows a student policy to internalize rich teacher conditioning along its own sampled trajectories. Recent methods instantiate this teacher context with annotated helper images in Visual-OPSD ( Li et al., 2026a ) , image crops in Vision-OPD ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , annealed contexts in ATESD ( Han et al., 2026 ) , and hindsight skills in SEED ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自演培训框架通过过滤自生自出轨迹(Zelikman等,2022;Gulcehre等,2023;Dong等,2023;Yuan等,2023)或优化结果奖励和自演(Chen等,2024b;DeepSeek-AI,2025.),在无人理由的情况下反复提高模型能力。 相关工作还评价中间步骤是否真正有助于通过点心相互信息(PMI)和反事实干预(Church and Hanks,1990;Koh and Liang,2017;Lanham等人,2023;Turpin等人,2023)进行预测。 一个互补的范例是使用特权信息学习(Vapnik和Vashist,2009年;Hinton等人,2015年;Lopez-Paz等人,2016年),为一名教师提供测试时学生无法获得的培训信号。 将特权背景与政策背景蒸馏相结合(Askell等,2021;Snell等,2022;Agarwal等,2024),使得学生政策能够按照自己被采样的轨迹将丰富的师资条件内化. 近代方法在Visual-OPSD(Li等,2026年a)中以附加说明的帮助者图像即时化这种教师背景,在Visual-OPD(Yuan等,2026年)中以图像收成(Atvision-OPD),在ATESD(Han等,2026年)中以厌世为背景,在SEEED(Wu等,2026年)中以后起之技.

blocks.en: When ground-truth labels are unavailable during self-training, majority voting across rollouts provides a label-free supervision signal ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Zuo et al., 2025 ) . Recent self-distillation methods such as u-OPSD ( Li et al., 2026b ) and Canon ( Gkountouras et al., 2026 ) condition the teacher on a consensus text solution, while UniGame pits generation against understanding in an adversarial loop ( Su et al., 2025 ) . As summarized in Table 1 , prior training pipelines either require human-annotated helper images and external crops (ThinkMorph, Visual-OPSD, Vision-OPD) or distill text-only consensus solutions without visual thoughts (u-OPSD, Canon). SelfThinker bridges this gap through a unified self-evolving training loop. Rather than distilling dataset-provided visual annotations, we use conditional PMI against mismatched thoughts to verify helper images synthesized by the model itself, and distill the verified imagery into fast text-only inference.

SelfThinker通过统一的自演训练循环来弥补这一缺口. 与其提炼数据集提供的可视化说明,我们用有条件的PMI对抗不匹配的思想来验证由模型本身合成的帮助者图像,再将已核实的图像提炼成快速的文本唯一推断.

blocks.en: Directly training on self-generated trajectories faces two obstacles. First, a correct text answer a ( k ) = a ⋆ a^{(k)}=a^{\star} can arise despite an uninformative or corrupted helper image v ( k ) v^{(k)} ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Second, running image generation π θ G \pi_{\theta}^{G} at test time incurs substantial latency, whereas disabling it causes premature termination at <image_start> . As illustrated in Fig. 1 and Algorithm 1 , SelfThinker addresses both issues through two subsequent stages. In the Verify stage (Sect. 3.2 ), the understanding pathway scores the task utility of each candidate helper image v ( k ) v^{(k)} without human image annotations. In the Evolve stage, the model internalizes the verified visual context into the understanding pathway via on-policy self-distillation (Sect. 3.4 ), supported by flow-matching refinement of the generation pathway (Sect. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We build on ThinkMorph-7B ( Gu et al., 2025 ) , an interleaved reasoning model fine-tuned from BAGEL-7B-MoT ( Deng et al., 2025 ) (denoted BAGEL-7B ). The model routes understanding and generation tokens through specialized Qwen2.5 transformer experts ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) paired with a SigLIP vision encoder ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) . All intrinsic utility scores are evaluated by the frozen understanding pathway of ThinkMorph-7B. We evaluate our self-distilled understanding models across training pools and supervision settings: SelfThinker (Nav) (distilled from verified navigation thoughts), SelfThinker (Mix) (distilled from combined navigation and visual-search thoughts), SelfThinker (Vote) (distilled from visual-search thoughts verified via label-free majority voting), and our primary model SelfThinker (distilled from visual-search thoughts verified via ground-truth answers). In our ablation studies (Sect. 4.5 ), we also evaluate two teacher-context controls under identical visual-search training schedules. Specifically, Noise-OPSD replaces the teacher’s verified thought with uniform RGB noise, and Prompt-OPSD omits the second image so the teacher observes only the problem and transition instruction. For the generation pathway, we compare our supporting generative update ( SelfThinker -Gen) against random-thought fine-tuning ( Rand-RFT ).
blocks.zh: 我们以ThinkMorph-7B(Gu等,2025年)为基础,这是一个从BAGEL-7B-MoT(Deng等,2025年)(已注BAGEL-7B.)中微调的互分推理模型。 模型路线通过专业的Quen2.5变压器专家(Quen Team,2024年)来理解并生成代币,并配以一款SigLIP视觉编码器(Zhai等,2023年). 所有内在的功用分数都通过ThinkMorph-7B被冻结的理解路径来评价. 我们评价我们在整个训练池和监督环境中自我扭曲的理解模式:SelfThinker(从经核实的导航思想中分离出)、SelfThinker(从综合导航和视觉研究思想中分离出)、SelfThinker(从通过无标签多数投票核实的视觉研究思想中分离出)、以及我们的主要模式SelfThinker(从通过地面真实答案核实的视觉研究思想中分离出)。 在我们的研究(第4.5节)中,我们还根据相同的视觉搜索培训时间表评估了两个教师文本控制。 校对:Soup 对于生成路径,我们将支持基因更新(SelfThinker-Gen)与随机思维微调(Rand-RFT)进行比较.

blocks.en: To evaluate candidate visual thoughts on layouts unseen during ThinkMorph-7B training, we synthesize fresh Navigation (Frozen-Lake grid maps ( Towers et al., 2024 ) ) and Visual Search (multi-object shape canvases) pools. Each pool is split into 1,500 training and 500 diagnostic items with disjoint layouts. For each problem, we sample K = 6 K=6 interleaved traces with one visual thought per trace. Programmatic reference thoughts (shortest-path overlays and target boxes) are rendered only for post-hoc diagnostics and are never used in verification or training. Complete pool specifications, sampling parameters, and optimization schedules are provided in Appendix 6 .
blocks.zh: 为了评价ThinkMorph-7B训练期间所未见的布局的候选视觉思想,我们合成了新鲜的导航图(Frozen-Lake网格图(Towers等,2024))和视觉搜索(多对象形状画布)池. 每个游泳池分为1500个训练品和500个诊断品,布局不统一. 对于每一个问题,我们抽样K=6K=6 相接的痕迹,每个痕量有一个视觉思考. 方案参考思想(最短的路径覆盖和目标箱)仅用于热后诊断,从未用于核查或培训。 完整的集合规格、取样参数和优化时间表见附录6。

blocks.en: Following the benchmark suite of Li et al. (2026a) , we evaluate multimodal reasoning across seven benchmarks: VSP (600 maze items) ( Wu et al., 2024b ) , ChartQA (444 horizontal and 382 vertical bar items) ( Masry et al., 2022 ) , V* (191 items) ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ) , MMVP (300 items) ( Tong et al., 2024c ) , SAT (150 circular split items) ( Ray et al., 2024 ) , BLINK (1,901 items across 14 subtasks) ( Fu et al., 2024 ) , and CV-Bench (1,438 2D and 1,200 3D items) ( Tong et al., 2024a ) . All benchmarks are evaluated in VLMEvalKit ( Duan et al., 2024 ) using greedy text-only decoding (up to 1,024 thinking tokens) and a unified Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 judge ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Kwon et al., 2023 ) . On the 500-item diagnostic splits, we evaluate intrinsic verification using four metrics: verification yield , Top-1 AUC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve) ( Hanley and McNeil, 1982 ) , paired win rate , and utility margin (nats) (formal definitions in Appendix 7 ). Finally, to test whether accuracy gains stem from visual perception rather than language priors, we evaluate a multi-layer image-condition probe across image swaps, pixel scrambles, tile permutations, mosaics, and Gaussian blurs (Appendix 11 ).
blocks.zh: 按照Li等人的基准套件(2026a),我们评价了7个基准的多式联运推理:VSP(600个迷宫项目)(Wu等,2024b),ChartQA(444个横向项目和382个纵向项目)(Masry等,2022),V* (191个项目) (Wu and Xie, 2024), MMVP (300个项目)(Tong等, 2024c), SAT (150个循环分出项目)(Ray等, 2024), BLINK (1,901个项目跨越14个分任务)(Fu等, 2024), CV-Bench (1,438个2D和1,200个3D项目)(Tong等, 2024a). 所有基准均在VLMEvalKit(Duan等,2024年)中使用贪婪的文本专用解码(可达1,024个思维符)和统一的Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507法官(Yang等,2025a; Kwon等, 2023 (英语). 关于500项诊断分裂,我们用四个衡量标准评价内在核查:核查产量、Top-1AUC(接收器操作特征曲线下的区域)(Hanley和McNeil,1982年),双赢率和效用差(nats)(附录7中的正式定义)。 最后,为了测试精度是否来自视觉感知而不是语言前传,我们评价一个多层次的图像条件探测器,它跨越了图像交换,像素拼接,瓦片穿透,镶嵌,高斯模糊(附录11 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要基准成果

blocks.en: Table 2 and Fig. 2 present the main benchmark comparison. By distilling verified visual thoughts into the understanding pathway, SelfThinker raises the seven-benchmark average from 52.7 to 64.0 ( + 11.3 +11.3 points) . It outperforms ThinkMorph-7B on every benchmark while operating purely in text mode at test time, avoiding the 59–75 s per-trace diffusion overhead required by interleaved image generation. Notably, even though training uses only a small pool of synthetic navigation or visual-search problems, the distilled visual supervision transfers broadly across natural-image and spatial benchmarks. Specifically, SelfThinker (Nav) lifts the seven-benchmark average to 60.0 ( + 7.3 +7.3 points, reaching 60.3 on BLINK), SelfThinker (Mix) reaches 60.8 ( + 8.1 +8.1 points, reaching 83.5 on CV-Bench), label-free SelfThinker (Vote) reaches 63.4 ( + 10.7 +10.7 points, reaching 81.9 on ChartQA), and SelfThinker reaches 64.0 ( + 11.3 +11.3 points).
blocks.zh: 表2和图2为主要基准比较。 SelfThinker通过将经核实的视觉思维分解入理解路径,将7个基准的平均值从52.7提高到64.0(+11.3+11.3分). 它在每一个基准上都超过了ThinkMorph-7B,同时在测试时纯粹在文本模式下运行,避免了互出图像生成所需的59-75 s每轨相传播的间接费用. 值得注意的是,尽管培训只使用一小堆合成导航或视觉搜索问题,但蒸馏的视觉监督广泛跨越自然图像和空间基准。 具体来说,SelfThinker(Nav)将7个基准平均提升到60.0分(+ 7.3+7.3分,在BLINK上达到60.3),SelfThinker(Mix)达到60.8分(+8.1+8.1分,在CV-Bench上达到83.5分),无标签的SelfThinker(Vote)达到63.4分(+10.7+10.7分,在ChartQA上达到81.9分),SelfThinker达到64.0分(+11.3+11.3分).

blocks.en: Grouping the benchmarks by task type shows how self-generated visual supervision transfers to diverse visual domains. On fine-grained visual reading and search tasks that require locating small objects or reading dense charts, SelfThinker improves ChartQA by + 27.4 +27.4 points (to 80.1, and 81.9 for SelfThinker (Vote)) and V* by + 16.3 +16.3 points (to 70.2) . On multi-step spatial planning, SelfThinker lifts VSP maze navigation from near-failure (1.2) to 15.8 ( + 14.6 +14.6 points) without drawing intermediate paths at test time , while improving perspective reasoning on SAT by + 4.7 +4.7 points (to 60.0). On 2D and 3D natural-scene perception, SelfThinker consistently advances CV-Bench ( + 8.3 +8.3 , to 81.7), BLINK ( + 4.6 +4.6 , to 58.2), and MMVP ( + 3.3 +3.3 , to 82.3) .
blocks.zh: 按任务类型对基准进行分组,说明自我生成的视觉监督如何向各种视觉领域转移。 在需要定位小物体或读取稠密图表的精细视觉读取和搜索任务上,SelfThinker将图QA改进为+27.4+27.4分(为80.1分;SelfThinker (Vote)为81.9分;而V*则改进为+16.3+16.3分(为70.2). 在多步空间规划上,SelfThinker将VSP迷宫导航从接近故障(1.2分)提升到15.8分(+14.6分+14.6分),而不在测试时绘制中间路径,同时将SAT的视角推理改进为+4.7分+4.7分(至60.0分). 在2D和3D自然-场景感知上,SelfThinker一致地将CV-Bench(+ 8.3+8.3,至81.7),BLINK(+ 4.6+4.6,至58.2)和MMVP(+3.3+3.3,至82.3)推进.

blocks.en: 4.3 Cross-Task Perception Transfer and Internalization
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨任务感知转移和内化

blocks.en: To verify that these cross-task gains reflect stronger visual perception rather than language shortcuts, we compare SelfThinker against both ThinkMorph-7B and its pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone under the 512-token image-condition probe (Fig. 3 b; full 256- and 512-token corruption tables in Appendix 11 ). Across all four spatial and object-perception benchmarks, SelfThinker surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by 33.0 to 40.4 points and outperforms the pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by 12.0 to 23.2 points . Specifically, SelfThinker reaches 67.0% on V* ( + 18.3 +18.3 over BAGEL-7B), 78.0% on MMVP ( + 12.0 +12.0 ), 83.4% on CV-Bench-2D ( + 20.9 +20.9 ), and 82.0% on CV-Bench-3D ( + 23.2 +23.2 ), while also lifting ChartQA-h/v under the 256-token probe from 32.2%–32.5% in ThinkMorph-7B to 67.3%–68.6% (Table 10 ). Because pixel-scramble accuracy remains at a similar baseline across all three models, the entire improvement over BAGEL-7B stems from stronger visual evidence extraction from the real problem image . Graded mosaic, Gaussian blur, and tile-permutation ladders in Appendix 11 further show that SelfThinker preserves global inter-object geometry across 2 × 2 2\times 2 to 8 × 8 8\times 8 mosaics and mild blur on 2D and 3D spatial tasks, while extracting fine local glyphs on ChartQA.
blocks.zh: 为了核实这些跨任务成果反映的是更强的视觉感知而不是语言捷径,我们比较了SelfThinker与ThinkMorph-7B及其预先训练的BAGEL-7B主干线在512token图像条件探测器(图3b;附录11中完整的256-和512token腐败表)下的对比. 在所有四个空间和物体感知基准中,SelfThinker超过ThinkMorph-7B的33.0至40.4分,超越了预先训练的BAGEL-7B主干线12.0至23.2分。 具体而言,SelfThinker在V*(BAGEL-7B的+18.3+18.3)上达到67.0%,在MMVP(+12.0+12.0)上达到78.0%,在CV-Bench-2D(+20.9+20.9)上达到83.4%,在CV-Bench-3D(+23.2+23.2)上达到82.0%,同时将ChartQA-h/v从ThinkMorph-7B的32.2%-32.5%提升到67.3%-68.6%(表10)。 由于像素-散射精度在所有三种模型中都保持了相近的基线,所以比起BAGEL-7B,整个改进来自于从真实问题图像中更强的视觉证据取出. . 分级的马赛克,高斯克模糊,以及附录11中的瓷砖-平面阶梯进一步显示,自平克保存了2×2 2×8 2×8 8相8相8相8相8相8相8相8相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2相2

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 a, when test-time image generation is disabled, ThinkMorph-7B frequently halts prematurely at the <image_start> token, completing a final text answer on only 32% to 73% of items across V*, CV-Bench-2D, ChartQA-h, MMVP, and SAT. SelfThinker raises direct text answer completion to 77%–100% (reaching 100% on V* and 99% on SAT) . Crucially, on the paired subsets of items where ThinkMorph-7B already states an answer before <image_start> , SelfThinker still improves conditional accuracy under the 512-token probe from 35.3% to 66.8% on V* ( + 31.5 +31.5 points), from 46.6% to 82.9% on CV-Bench-2D ( + 36.3 +36.3 ), from 37.2% to 68.4% on ChartQA-h ( + 31.3 +31.3 ), from 48.9% to 77.4% on MMVP ( + 28.5 +28.5 ), and from 50.4% to 60.0% on SAT ( + 9.6 +9.6 ) . This confirms that self-distillation strengthens visual reasoning itself rather than merely repairing answer formatting.
blocks.zh: 如图3a所示,当测试时间图像生成被禁用时,ThinkMorph-7B经常会过早地在"image_start"的标志上停止,在V*、CV-Bench-2D、ChartQA-h、MMVP和SAT上只完成了32%到73%的项目的最后文本回答。 SelfThinker将直接文本解答完成率提高到77-100%(在V*上达到100%,在SAT上达到99%)。 关键是,对于 ThinkMorph-7B 已经在<image_start> 之前表示答案的项目的对接子集, SelfThinker在512托肯探测器下的条件精度仍然从35.3%提高到66.8%在V*上(+31.5+31.5分),从46.6%提高到82.9%在CV-Bench-2D上(+36.3+36.3),从37.2%提高到68.4%在图QA-h上(+31.3+31.3),从48.9%提高到77.4%在MVP上(+28.5+28.5分),从50.4%提高到60.0%在SAT上(+9.6+9.6)。 这证实了自我消化强化了视觉推理本身,而不仅仅是修复答案格式.

blocks.en: To verify that the student has absorbed the privileged teacher conditioning into single-image reasoning, we perform controlled context interventions on the 1,092 verified visual-search items (Table 9 and Fig. 9 in Appendix 10 ). Whereas ThinkMorph-7B drops by 6.1 points when the verified visual thought is removed at test time (45.9% with the thought versus 39.7% with the problem image alone), SelfThinker achieves virtually identical accuracy whether given the problem plus its verified thought (99.0%) or the problem image alone (98.9%, a difference of + 0.1 +0.1 points) . Label-free SelfThinker (Vote) likewise matches at 95.4% versus 95.3% ( + 0.1 +0.1 points). Conversely, when the problem image is withheld and only the verified thought is shown, SelfThinker and SelfThinker (Vote) reach 96.5% and 93.0% accuracy (versus 35.4% for ThinkMorph-7B) , showing that distillation sharpens the model’s visual reader. To evaluate generalization on unseen problem types, we also test SelfThinker (Nav), which is distilled solely on grid navigation and never exposed to visual-search items. SelfThinker (Nav) transfers zero-shot to the 1,092 visual-search problems at 92.9% single-image accuracy (with a 0.0 0.0 -point gap between with and without the visual thought, up from 39.7% in ThinkMorph-7B) .

blocks.en: We first examine how much answer evidence the frozen understanding pathway extracts from ThinkMorph’s human-annotated helper images across its training tasks (Fig. 4 a). Prescribing a fixed helper-image template per task does not guarantee that the model’s reader can extract useful evidence from it; scoring candidate thoughts directly through the understanding pathway provides a task-agnostic criterion for selecting informative visual expressions.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SelfThinker , a self-evolving framework that turns a unified multimodal model’s image generation capability into training supervision for visual understanding without human image annotations. By scoring candidate visual thoughts through the model’s frozen understanding pathway via calibrated conditional pointwise mutual information, SelfThinker selects informative helper images under both ground-truth answers and label-free majority votes. Distilling these verified visual thoughts into the understanding pathway via privileged on-policy self-distillation, supported by flow-matching generator refinement, enables the deployed model to reason directly from the original image in text without generating images at test time. Although trained only on small synthetic visual-search and navigation pools, SelfThinker improves the seven-benchmark average of ThinkMorph-7B by + 11.3 +11.3 points (and by + 10.7 +10.7 points under label-free majority voting). Controlled image-perturbation probes further show that this self-generated visual supervision transfers broadly across tasks, unlocking fine-grained and 2D/3D spatial perception that surpasses ThinkMorph-7B by up to 40.4 points and the pretrained BAGEL-7B backbone by up to 23.2 points.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SelfThinker——一个自我演变的框架,将统一的多模式模型的图像生成能力转变为培训监督,在没有人类图像说明的情况下进行视觉理解。 SelfThinker通过该模型的冷冻理解路径,通过校准有条件的点入点互通信息来评分候选人的视觉思维,在地面真实答案和无标签多数选票下选择信息化的帮助者图像。 将这些经过核实的视觉想法通过特权政策自我消化,辅之以流量匹配生成器的精细化,使部署的模型能够直接从文字中的原始图像中推理,而不在测试时生成图像。 SelfThinker虽然只接受过小合成视觉搜索和导航池的培训,但通过+11.3+11.3分(以及以+10.7+10.7分在无标签多数投票下)来提高ThinkMorph-7B的7个基准平均值. 被控制的图像-扰动探测器还进一步显示,这种自发产生的视觉监督在任务之间广泛转移,解锁了精细的和2D/3D空间感知,超过ThinkMorph-7B最高可达40.4分,预训的BAGEL-7B骨干最多可达23.2分.

blocks.en: On the 500-item diagnostic splits, the utility margin is the mean difference u ⁡ ( v ) − u ⁡ ( v mis ) u(v)-u(v_{\mathrm{mis}}) in nats across all candidate pairs, and the win rate is the percentage of pairs with u ⁡ ( v ) > u ⁡ ( v mis ) u(v)>u(v_{\mathrm{mis}}) . The Top-1 AUC computes the area under the ROC curve comparing each item’s top intrinsic thought against the mean of its mismatched utilities ( Hanley and McNeil, 1982 ) , and the yield is the fraction of items whose top thought exceeds Q i Q_{i} . As an analytical diagnostic for label-free verification, we also report metrics on the accurate-vote subset where the rollout majority vote a ~ \tilde{a} matches a ⋆ a^{\star} .

Each visual-search thought is converted to RGB, and a pixel is classified as red if r ≥ 160 r\geq 160 , g ≤ 90 g\leq 90 , b ≤ 90 b\leq 90 , and r − max ⁡ ( g , b ) > 50 r-\max(g,b)>50 . blocks.en: We evaluate how ThinkMorph-7B and the SelfThinker students respond to five controlled context interventions on the 1,092 verified visual-search items (Table 9 and Fig. 9 ). Whereas ThinkMorph-7B loses 6.1 percentage points when the helper image is removed at test time (45.9% with “Own” versus 39.7% with “None”), SelfThinker and label-free SelfThinker (Vote) achieve virtually identical accuracy whether given the item’s own verified thought (99.0% and 95.4%) or no second image at all (98.9% and 95.3%, a difference of + 0.1 +0.1 points) . This confirms that the distilled students absorb the privileged visual conditioning without requiring a second image at deployment. Appending a neutral sentence leaves accuracy unchanged (98.9% and 95.3%). When the problem image is withheld and only the verified visual thought is shown (“Thought only”), SelfThinker and SelfThinker (Vote) achieve 96.5% and 93.0% accuracy (compared with 35.4% for ThinkMorph-7B) , demonstrating that their understanding pathway directly extracts the solution from the verified thought. Furthermore, to test generalization on unseen problem types, SelfThinker (Nav), trained solely on navigation problems, reaches 92.9% zero-shot on these 1,092 visual-search items both with and without the visual thought ( 0.0 0.0 -point gap, up from 45.9% and 39.7% for ThinkMorph-7B) .

blocks.en: Tables 10 , 11 , and 12 report the complete results of the image-condition probe at 256 and 512 thinking tokens. Figures 10 , 11 , and 12 illustrate the visual transformations, the per-benchmark visual-sensitivity heatmaps, and the three degradation ladders. Unlike the main benchmark evaluation in Table 2 (which uses 1,024 thinking tokens and semantic grading by Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507), the image-condition probe uses a strict 256- or 512-token budget and deterministic rule-based extraction (the last standalone option letter for multiple-choice items or the last number within 5% relative error for ChartQA) to isolate visual sensitivity under controlled image corruptions. The prompt presents a single image and the question, and multiple-choice items append “Answer with a single letter.” Final answers are extracted from explicit <answer> tags or post- </think> text when present, falling back to the last standalone option letter or number before <image_start> . Image swaps use the previous row of the benchmark file on the subset of items whose previous row depicts a distinct image (222 horizontal and 191 vertical ChartQA items, 1,198 CV-Bench-3D items, and all items elsewhere). Pixel scrambles permute all pixels deterministically, and g × g g\times g tile permutations partition the image into g 2 g^{2} equal rectangular patches and shuffle those patches, preserving local detail inside each patch while disrupting global spatial layout. Mosaics apply box downsampling by factor k ∈ { 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 } k\in\{2,4,8,16\} followed by nearest-neighbour upsampling, and blurs apply a Gaussian kernel with σ ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 } \sigma\in\{1,2,4,8\} pixels at native resolution.

blocks.en: At 256 thinking tokens (Fig. 11 and Tables 10 – 11 ), SelfThinker achieves the highest accuracy on every benchmark: 67.3%–68.6% on ChartQA-h/v, 67.0% on V*, 78.0% on MMVP, 83.5% on CV-Bench-2D, and 81.8% on CV-Bench-3D , outperforming ThinkMorph-7B (32.2%–46.8%) by wide margins. blocks.en: Comparing the transformation families across Tables 10 – 12 and Fig. 12 highlights two complementary visual perception capabilities. On ChartQA horizontal and vertical bars (Table 10 ), SelfThinker preserves high accuracy on 2 × 2 2\times 2 -pixel mosaics (64.9% and 63.1%) and σ = 1 \sigma=1 blur (68.9% and 63.4%) , demonstrating strong local glyph reading. On V*, MMVP, CV-Bench-2D, and CV-Bench-3D at 512 thinking tokens (Table 12 and Fig. 12 ), SelfThinker preserves its large advantage over both ThinkMorph-7B and pretrained BAGEL-7B across 2 × 2 2\times 2 to 8 × 8 8\times 8 -pixel mosaics, mild blur ( σ = 2 , 4 \sigma=2,4 ), and 2 × 2 2\times 2 to 16 × 16 16\times 16 tile permutations . Specifically, on CV-Bench-2D, SelfThinker achieves 82.8%, 80.7%, and 75.2% across × 2 , × 4 , × 8 \times 2,\times 4,\times 8 mosaics (versus 32.5% on scramble), and on CV-Bench-3D it achieves 82.2% and 77.2% across × 4 \times 4 and × 8 \times 8 mosaics (versus 54.5% on scramble). Together with the 12.0 to 23.2 point improvement over pretrained BAGEL-7B across all four spatial and object-level benchmarks (Table 12 ), these results confirm that SelfThinker unlocks high-precision visual perception across both fine local details and global scene geometry.
